01

The journey

From field
to attic.

01 / 04

Grown on the high plains

It begins in a Texas sorghum field. Our farmer-growers deliver naturally grown, non-GMO sorghum seeds, or "berries", to our processing mill in Tulia, Texas. A renewable agricultural crop, grown by local farmers, supporting American agriculture.

02 / 04

Refined to the grain

These tiny sorghum berries are passed through state-of-the-art equipment in our patented manufacturing process. All fats and sugars are removed, rendering MILEX™ a non-food source that pests are naturally not attracted to.

03 / 04

Engineered into Thermal Puffs™

Once refined, the berries are extruded at high speed with more than 3000 psi, creating our amazing Thermal Puffs™. Each puff contains thousands of tiny air pockets that create an incredible thermal blanket.

04 / 04

Installed for a lifetime

Blown into your attic, MILEX™ resists shrinking, sagging, and settling far better than traditional materials. Continuous comfort through the hottest summer days and the coldest winter nights, backed by our Transferable Lifetime Warranty.

02

The hidden threat above you

What's lurking
in your attic

Most homeowners never look up. But what's hiding above your ceiling could be costing you money, degrading your air quality, and chipping away at your family's comfort.

A

Allergens & toxins

Dust, debris, and airborne particles from degraded insulation can circulate through your HVAC system into every room, affecting the air your family breathes and the comfort of your home.

B

Pests & rodents

Traditional insulation is a five-star hotel for rodents, cockroaches, and termites. They nest, breed, and leave behind droppings that contaminate the air your family breathes every single day.

C

Money bleeding out

That glow on a thermal scan is your money escaping through the roof. Inadequate insulation forces your HVAC to work overtime, and you pay for it on every energy bill.

Many older homes have insulation that has degraded well below the levels recommended for their climate zone. Is yours one of them?

04

Welcome to the future

The future of blow-in insulation

MILO INSULATION™ proudly produces MILEX™, an innovative natural insulation crafted exclusively from grain sorghum.

Using state-of-the-art equipment and a patented production process, our flagship loose-fill insulation product, MILEX™ Thermal MAX®, is made using natural, sustainable, plant-based ingredients without the use of expensive, potentially harmful polymers.

Unlike traditional insulation materials, MILEX™ Thermal MAX® maintains its structure over time, significantly reducing or even eliminating the need for reinsulating. This durability can significantly reduce re-insulation costs over the life of their home.

Biodegradable to ISO standards, MILEX™ Thermal MAX® is produced from sustainably sourced sorghum grain, a renewable agricultural crop grown by local farmers on our nation's high plains.

MILEX™ Thermal MAX® offers homeowners a natural, affordable alternative to traditional insulation products. We believe it stands apart from traditional blow-in insulation, and we are confident you will feel the difference.
